foreground: first maximum physical EDT voxel inside threshold-ROI fallback
negative_pool: first-pass label 1 AND HU > -400 AND distance outside fallback > 4 mm AND distance from centered point > 12 mm
negative_selection: nearest eligible voxel to centered point; farthest eligible voxel from first negative; numpy argmin/argmax ordering; omit duplicate
empty_negative_pool: centered foreground only; no invented negatives
final_pass: centered point label 1, up to two negatives label 0
mask: label == 1; no morphology, clipping, or component removal
fallback_parameters: unchanged scripts/b5_threshold.py: HU -400, 32 mm crop, opening/closing 2 voxel iterations, lung-mask helper
